name: Product Name
description: Common or generic name of the commodity must be declared on the package.

name: Manufacturer
description: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be declared.

name: Net Quantity
description: Net quantity in standard units of weight, measure, or number must be declared.

name: MRP
description: Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes must be declared.

name: Consumer Information
description: Consumer care contact details (phone and/or email address) must be declared.
